page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening) with one column of running text; no marginal notes on this page (the left edge shows show-through from the facing page, not transcribed); running head at top; page number at top right; catchword "tum" at the foot right; signature mark "O 5" at the foot.

main_text.p: ajunt incendio illo absumptas esse domos ultra quinquaginta millia: inter quas etiam Palatium Nikitzii, Imperatoris avunculi, quod inæstimabilis pretii fuisse perhibetur: structurâ pariter, ac sumptuosâ, qua refertum erat, supellectili stupendum: Cùmq; incendium istud inciderit in meridiem, perierunt tamen homines, sive flammis impliciti, sive fumo præfocati, mille septingenti. Hoc tunc etiam accidit memorabile: Sub mediam noctem, cum flamma jam perrexisset ad forum, ubi cella vinaria Imperatoris, in qua vinum adustum, cujus apud gentem istam creber potus, maximâ asservatur copiâ: cùmque periculum esset, ne si flammam concepisset, pereundem esset omnibus: ajunt Monachum quendam adfuisse, stricto gladio: quantum.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page is visible along the left edge and was not transcribed. Two small ink spots on the page were ignored. Some words are at the line ends and are printed with hyphens (in-, præ-, asser-, pericu-, quan-); the catchword "tum" is joined to the last line.
